# A Message Past the Gate

*Wat has a message from the warden for the shepherds' sheepfold on Downs Edge, and his shortcuts stop at the city gate. Carry it, and clear the bees around the fold.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Wat](../npcs/wat.md) |
| Level | 20 |
| Leads to | [A Better Hand Than Mine](../quests/wat_a_better_hand_than_mine.md) |

## Objectives

- Reach the sheepfold in [Downs Edge](../maps/downs_edge.md)
- Defeat 25 [Wild Bee](../monsters/wild_bee.md)

## Rewards

- 2,200 EXP
- 400 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Wat](../npcs/wat.md)
